title: How a hand‑crank ice‑cream maker works

facts.intro: The user grips the crank and begins to rotate it clockwise.
facts.reveal: The big gear, attached to the crank, starts turning with each full rotation.
facts.step1: The teeth of the big gear engage the left‑handed gear that sits beside it.
facts.step2: The left gear rotates in the opposite direction, pulling the inner barrel upward.
facts.step3: As the barrel rises, the frozen walls chill the ice‑cream mixture inside.
facts.step4: When the barrel reaches the top, the cam on the big gear releases it to drop back down.
facts.hold: Each repeat of this cycle draws more mixture into the cold zone and pushes frozen ice‑cream outward.
facts.payoff: Continuous cranking steadily freezes and churns the mixture into smooth ice‑cream.
